up-uhc: parts, licences and where the source is

Part                          Licence                          Source
----------------------------  -------------------------------  --------------------------------------------
UHC tools (downloaded)        by the author (Patrik, UHC)      https://uhc.megaburken.net/uhctools_os3.lha
install scripts, two stubs    UP-Term's licence                this package

Notes
- This package contains no UHC file. Install downloads the author's archive uhctools_os3.lha from his server
  (mirrors: uhc.driar.se, uhc.a1k.org, uhc.no0b.de, uhc.hex9d.com) and unpacks it as it is.
- Only S/uhcupdate and S/uhccheck are replaced, on your machine, by the two stubs of this package.
